name: HYDRA-UMC-IOS-CONTROL
build: flutter pub get && flutter build ios. Real iOS build requires Xcode.
notes: iOS/iPadOS control app with real-time WebSocket sync to HYDRA-UMC-SERVER. v0.1.4: a failed secure-storage delete during logout, or a partial saveToken() write (token saved, username save failed), could leave a real, orphaned token that a later loadToken() would resurrect - fixed with a plain, non-secret hydra_logged_out marker checked before secure storage is ever consulted, plus a best-effort revert of a partial write. Same fix ported from HYDRA-UMC-DSI. v0.1.7: a rejected session token (WS close 1008) now tries a stored refresh token before forcing logout, mirroring HYDRA-UMC-DSI's own refresh-token client.
